links.outcome: GPT-4/GPT-4o accuracy identifying TI-RADS features and categories on thyroid ultrasound versus radiologist reference standard
links.effect: GPT-4 showed high specificity but low sensitivity; benign nodules 25.0% sensitivity, 99.5% specificity; moderately suspicious 75% sensitivity, 22.2% specificity, 42.1% accuracy; isoechoic 5% vs 46%; cropped images performed worse.
links.quote: While GPT-4 and GPT-4o models show potential for improving the efficiency of thyroid nodule triage, their performance remains suboptimal, particularly in higher-risk categories.

screen.reason: Evaluates the diagnostic accuracy of GPT-4 and GPT-4o multimodal models on thyroid ultrasound images without testing a deployment practice or workflow safeguard.
